systems.country_label: Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (CRVS), National Civil Registration Authority

note: A national data framework that names 'CRVS/NCRA for population management' without saying what the system does, so no fact is recorded; it does carry a costed action plan for 2026-2030 (USD 18.2 million, 30% domestic, 55% partners, 15% private) that schedules 'CRVS digitization' in its 2027 phase and targets civil registration completeness for births and deaths above 90% by 2030 from a baseline given as to be determined.
